title: Sea Glass
description: See 15 blue cards from another character. Choose any number of them to add to your Deck.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: Upon pickup, displays 15 cards from the selected character's pool (5 Common, 5 Uncommon, 5 Rare). The player can select any number of these cards to add to their deck. Each character has a character-specific title variant (Demon Glass for Ironclad, Venom Glass for Silent, Gear Glass for Defect, Lich Glass for Necrobinder, Noble Glass for Regent).
